title: Detection of Five Bacterial Pathogens of Rice by Multiplex PCR
author: Martine Bangratz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcpaivie

steps.title: Calculate reagent quantities
steps.instruction: Determine the amounts needed for the number of samples you will process, based on the amounts given for one sample, and prepare a mixture that is 10 % larger than calculated.

steps.title: Prepare gel and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Make a 2 % agarose gel, then load 10 µL of each PCR product into the wells and run the gel at 100 V for 90 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Load 10 µL PCR product and electrophorese at 100 V for 90 min.

steps.title: Visualize gel under UV
steps.instruction: After staining the gel in an ethidium bromide bath, observe the bands under UV illumination.
